hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: Last night, I was scrubbing the hearth when the steam from the copper bathtub caught my eye. It was Lady Eleanor in her nightgown, lacing her stays by the dim light. I couldn't help but notice the way she moved, so graceful and seductive. I whispered to my fellow maid, Clara, and we both giggled. The ladies and maids whispering by the hearth...
caption:
Caught in the moment with the lady of the house. Who would have guessed?
